shared_or_similar_visual_information: A colored region delimited by the intersecting contours of two circles. On the left, use the tan lens containing 1, 4 and 13. On the right, use the pink Programming crescent labeled 64, outside the Data Analysis circle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens lists the elements that belong to both A and B. Right image: It represents employees with Programming only.
Rationales: The lens is inside both circle boundaries, so it requires both memberships. The crescent lies inside only one circle and excludes the shared members.
